body:
Hey Avicus Players & Awesome Others,
Welcome to Supert!
 
In Supert we have lots of fun making Unofficial NEWS for the AVICUS network.
We will have lots of pvp and gameplay as well as making news.
Now that I told you about us, You probably wondering what is the requirement and format for our team. All answers are below.

Team Info



          Members:
 
Team Leaders  (2):

[1] OldManTigerMask 
[2] Zeebond1 

Reporters (2):

[1] OldManTigerMask
[2]  mhanif62  
[3] Spot Available

Helpers (1):

[1] Mooch24 
[2] Spot Available
[3] Spot Available
[4] Spot Available
[5] Spot Available

PvP & Creativity (3)

[1] Zeebond1 
[2] vignesh2002
[3] mhanif62 

Back Ups (0)

[1] Spot Available
[2] Spot Available
[3] Spot Available
[4] Spot Available
[5] Spot Available


                                                               Position Explanation

Team Leaders:   Team Leaders are the director directing people or organizing to help everyone have a fun and exciting time!

Reporters:  Reporters are those who say the information that is written on teamspeak! And also help find information for us!

Helpers:  Helpers just help to set up everything right and do a few odd jobs for us!

PvP & Creativity:  All though we are not big on pvp and the team will meet up and have fun pvping, This group is just for those who are good at pvp and thinking up ideas!

Back Ups: If someone is away the back ups will take they're place so the news can go on! 


                                       The Merge

Hello, I recently came across a team named " Introneticals " I liked the format as well as being my sister hosting it for now! She offered me a deal for my team to go into their team! I accepted it.

WHAT WHAT WHY???

I'm the one to blame I dragged you into this but I think it is better because with a more responsible leader I'm pretty certain you will like this team!

So... is our position dead?

No your position is not dead you will be transferred onto Introneticals. Your position will be trial until you re apply on the Introneticals post. I'm sorry about this but really you probably will make it through!

Grr I wanna quit now!

Sure you can quit now! but really? A PvP Team free Entrance to? Isn't that Awesome!!

Welp. I'm Panicking!
CALM DOWN DON'T PANIC! Its ok everything is fine nothing bad is going to happen!

Team Info

PLEASE ASK ANY QUESTIONS BELOW AND I'LL ASK YAMATZU ABOUT IT!

MERGE IN <-- click the link
